name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing frequent patch updates across multiple supported version branches simultaneously. The latest release is v0.63.2 (open source) / v1.63.2 (enterprise), released on July 29, 2025. Multiple older branches (58.x through 63.x) are receiving concurrent patch releases, indicating strong long-term support practices. Full changelogs are available at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases but detailed per-release notes were not included in the provided changelog text.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license.
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple patch releases across several version branches were published on July 28–29, 2025.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase offers a managed cloud (Metabase Cloud) at https://www.metabase.com.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, SQLite, MongoDB, Druid, Oracle, Presto/Trino, Spark SQL, and more via drivers.

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers best-in-class visualizations and enterprise features but is proprietary, expensive, and lacks Metabase's simplicity for small teams.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash integrates tightly with dbt for a metrics-first workflow, making it ideal for dbt-heavy teams but less general-purpose than Metabase.
